query:
UPDATE posts
               SET createat     = $1,
                   updateat     = $2,
                   editat       = $3,
                   deleteat     = $4,
                   ispinned     = $5,
                   userid       = $6,
                   channelid    = $7,
                   rootid       = $8,
                   originalid   = $9,
                   message      = $10,
                   type         = $11,
                   props        = $12,
                   hashtags     = $13,
                   filenames    = $14,
                   fileids      = $15,
                   hasreactions = $16,
                   remoteid     = $17
             WHERE id = $18
